Doctoral researcher in the PharMetrX Research+ Program at the University of Potsdam, specializing in mathematical and statistical methods for pharmacometric modeling. My research combines quantitative modeling, Bayesian statistics, and data analysis to support model-informed drug development and precision dosing.

## Education

**Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics** — University of Potsdam &nbsp;·&nbsp; *04/2025 – present*

- Thesis: Bayesian Approaches in Model-Informed Precision Dosing (MIPD)
- Supervisor: Prof. Dr. Wilhelm Huisinga
- Co-Supervisor: Prof. Dr. Charlotte Kloft

**M.Sc. Mathematics** — University of Münster &nbsp;·&nbsp; *10/2021 – 11/2024*

- Thesis: The SIR Model of Epidemiology (grade 1.7)
- Supervisor: Prof. Dr. Gerold Alsmeyer

**B.Sc. (Research) in Mathematics** — Shiv Nadar University &nbsp;·&nbsp; *07/2017 – 07/2021*
